Title: Remove an item from the cart

▶ Start URL:    https://www.saucedemo.com/cart.html
▶ Requires Auth: Yes
▶ Test Data:
{
  "username": "standard_user",
  "password": "secret_sauce"
}

Preconditions:
  User is logged in as standard_user; Shopping Cart page is open with at least one item in the cart.

Steps to Execute:
  1. Locate the row for the target item in the Shopping Cart table
  2. Click the Remove button on that row

Expected Result:
  The removed item's row is no longer displayed in the Shopping Cart table.

Notes from prior verification:
  Verification snapshot confirmed the cart row and Remove button elements are present on the page. The dynamic post-action disappearance of the row must be validated at runtime (not verifiable from static DOM).
expected_outcome: The removed item's row is no longer displayed in the Shopping Cart table.
